extras.agent_focus: Print-on-demand, media and fulfilment platforms that host your uploads permanently and serve them cheaply. The question for every candidate was NOT 'can I upload' (all of them accept uploads) but: does the platform serve my ORIGINAL bytes back, unsigned, indefinitely, from a CDN I can hot-link? POD image hosts (Redbubble/Printful/Printify/Society6/Threadless/Zazzle/Etsy) all re-encode, cap at 20-300 MB and gate the write behind account setup — they are inverted (tiny ingress, no egress). The value in this niche is the DIGITAL-PRODUCT fulfilment layer and the 3D-model repositories, which are the two places where arbitrary file types survive ingest at GB scale.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
